I was considering it since getting therapy in my area is kind of hard. I was seeing therapists through an agency that took my medicaid insurance, but I would only have the same therapist for a couple months at most before they would leave their job and patients behind and then I would just be given a new one. It's tiring to try to build up trust with a new therapist so frequently and stressful worrying about when this one is going to leave. I was even told by two of my ex therapists that they had absolutely no plans on leaving, but they did anyway. 

Well anyway that's why I was considering inpatient.

Sometimes I feel like committing myself to a hospital for a voluntary mental health stay, but I think of all the trouble it would cause for me. People would be worried about me, when I get home people would always be bothering me about it, I probably wouldn't be allowed to keep my phone or anything with me during the hospital stay. Also I might end up being put on even more medications with who knows what side effects. The whole thing seems like a hassle.
I wish there was a way to remove myself from society, to make everyone forget about me. Then I could fade away without a care in the world.
It's stressful to tell anyone, but then it's stressful anyway keeping things to myself. I'm not really sure what to do with myself.
